transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um, hi. Yeah, nice to meet you too. 

I guess I'm just here because... well, I've been having some trouble lately. I've been turning in applications and, like, research notes for my classes, and they keep having these small mistakes in them. Just embarrassing stuff, really. Like putting the wrong date on a piece of artwork, or just completely skipping a question on a form. And... I don't know, it's frustrating because I really thought I had checked them over before handing them in. So, yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you often have trouble paying attention, even when you’re trying to focus?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... like, if I'm at my desk trying to read or write, it doesn't take much. A siren outside, or... people talking in the hall. Even just a random thought about an exhibit idea. I'll just sort of drift off, and then twenty minutes go by before I realize I stopped working. So, yeah. It happens.
Did you have these kinds of attention problems when you were a child?

Yeah... I guess so. Um, even back in elementary school, my teachers would write notes saying I had good ideas, but... I'd forget to turn in worksheets. Or just lose the instructions. Stuff like that. I guess I missed a lot of little details unless... well, unless my parents checked my backpack every night.
Do you often feel restless, like it’s hard to sit still?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I mean, I sit at my desk fine, mostly. Just... yeah, I don't really have that issue.
Do these attention problems cause trouble in other parts of your life too, besides school?

Yeah, I suppose. Um... I've handed in some assignments late. And... I missed a few deadlines for, like, internships and stuff. My mentor mentioned that my lack of follow-through is... well, she said it's starting to affect opportunities I should be getting. So... yeah.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying about many different things, even when there isn’t a specific problem right in front of you?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean, I don't really worry about things unless there's an actual reason to. So... no, not really.
